semanticChecks: Human error includes environment/labels/layout; education not equipment improvement; no injury not quality/schedule acceptance; classification not exhaustive cause list.
Assumptions versus actual signals, full part numbers versus suffix, focused attention versus surroundings, front versus feet/back conditions remain distinct without blaming effort alone.
Repetitive automatic action versus current changes; experienced worker can lack new method knowledge; past examples not current instructions; silence/nodding/no questions not comprehension.

Familiarity not inspection exemption; delayed delivery not shortcut permission; majority consent not safety condition; schedules/staffing and overload reviewed without relying on individual endurance.

Ambiguous instructions require target/scope/time clarity; repetition of sounds or yes response not target understanding; supervisor notice not whole-crew/shift dissemination; undated changes not confirmed current facts.
Reflex examples not recommended acts; dropped tools can affect people below; panic not personality alone; emergency contacts/roles and route changes retained without adding procedures.

Individual body/mind/vision conditions not age-only assessment; environmental readability matters; fatigue involves sleep and workload/schedule/rest, not willpower alone; unusual health changes directed to appropriate contact without speculative diagnosis.
limitations: AI translation and author self-review only. No independent native-speaker, technical, rights or release approval. Translates authored source without independently updating legal/safety or medical guidance.
